text:
Plan Meridian's 24 modules using only final values; earlier drafts are withdrawn.

Fixed: tenant,checkout timeout_s=70; pricing timeout_s=120; indexer timeout_s=55; backup timeout_s=110; shipping timeout_s=30,ttl_s=450; export ttl_s=480; media ttl_s=600; archive batch_size=900; ledger max_workers=16; audit max_workers=8; inventory queue_depth=490; billing queue_depth=270; pricing queue_depth=250; reports retry_limit=8.

Conditional: backup timeout_s>100→indexer batch_size≤200; tenant timeout_s>60→profile ttl_s≥540; shipping timeout_s>15→gateway max_workers≥28; indexer timeout_s>45→profile batch_size≥900; export ttl_s>450→media queue_depth≤10; billing queue_depth>240→tenant retry_limit≤2; pricing timeout_s>105→auth ttl_s≤60; shipping ttl_s>420→sync queue_depth≥480.

Owners: tenant,indexer→alpha; webhooks,search→gamma; billing→beta; profile,reports,notify→delta. Those are exclusive.

Same worker: tenant+checkout; billing+media; backup+quota; inventory+shipping. Apart: backup/media; auth/cache; alerts/archive; indexer/shipping.

Deps: auth→search,shipping; tenant→archive; billing→inventory; webhooks→media; notify→audit; gateway→search; profile→inventory. No dependency path, direct or transitive: reports→notify; quota→gateway; archive→sync; indexer→auth.

Order: alerts before webhooks; billing before tenant; audit before sync. Rollout: gateway before cache.

Files: rules.py→sync; bench.py→media; specs.py→inventory; guard.py,flags.py→audit; client.py→quota; forms.py→webhooks; views.py→reports.

Rest: team judgment.
